steps.title: Keep a permitted completed direct native player
steps.instruction: Use an already permitted working official v1.0 Windows x64 svr07.exe and the complete actual installation, with existing Windows10/11/D3D12 support. Root BSD3 covers project code, not original game/assets/trademarks or exhaustive dependency/package clearance. The publisher explicitly documents native release use with a legally owned original; this is not whole-package/source-to-binary or gameplay certification.

steps.title: Preserve the exact own extracted original
steps.instruction: Complete upstream preparation using your own WWE SmackDown vs. Raw 2007 Xbox 360 original. USA/Canada is recommended; other regions are untested. Keep assets/ and the complete extracted files/default.xex, existing title-update paths and original set. Core does not extract an ISO, authenticate a full disc/XEX, install an update or establish arbitrary regional/revision compatibility.

steps.title: Select the game rather than the settings prelauncher
steps.instruction: Select the actual already working svr07.exe game entry, zero arguments for the normal prepared copy, and its established writable containing installation-root CWD. The official release also advertises a settings prelauncher; complete settings there separately and select the long-lived native game for Core Play. Preserve any already required supported custom literal arguments/profile context; do not select an updater, SDK/build/helper or DLL. Registration itself does not prepare or launch the game.

steps.title: Review intent and keep replacement upstream-owned
steps.instruction: Review and consent to the exact native executable, actual initial working directory and literal arguments; choose Play separately. Core observes the selected process, not an exclusive family or sandbox. Upstream/player owns original extraction, setup, repair and actual replacement. Close all real instances before changing files, retain the old creating copy and review a changed executable through relink. Removing registration removes only metadata and preserves external bytes.

steps.title: Preserve every actual root and creating profile
steps.instruction: Keep the whole runtime, original/extracted assets, actual configuration, save/user content, title-update data, logs/caches/mods/custom and unknown paths. The title source uses application name svr07 and overrides update_data_root to a rooted assets/1_update coordinate; do not rewrite/create that path merely to register. The named runtime-fork observation uses a Windows Documents/svr07 default user root, but is not pinned to the selected release binary: preserve the actual established profile/custom roots rather than inferring or migrating it from that example. Keep state with its creating runtime; removal preserves all external bytes.
